description:
Cortisol Detox Music | Bansuri & Tanpura | 1.5 Hours for a Calm Morning

Cortisol — the body's stress hormone — peaks in the first hour after you wake. If your mornings start anxious, heart already racing before the day has even begun, you're not imagining it.

This gentle Indian flute music is designed to ease that early tension and give your nervous system a softer start — calm first, day second.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of soft, breathy bansuri in the traditional dawn raga, floating over a warm tanpura drone — no percussion, no builds, just slow even phrases.

Perfect for easing morning anxiety, meditation and breathwork, slow mornings, gentle stretching or yoga, morning tea or coffee in quiet, journaling, or a gentler alternative to reaching for your phone.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri — a bamboo flute with a soft, breathy, human warmth
Raga: Bhairavi — the classic dawn raga, devotional and gently grounding
Style: Slow Indian classical morning meditation
Mood: Soft, settling, quietly hopeful
Atmosphere: Early light, unhurried, warm
Duration: 1.5 hours, uninterrupted

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it in the first hour of your day — while you wake, stretch, breathe, or sit with your tea. Let the flute set your pace before the world sets it for you.

⏱ CHAPTERS

0:10  The breath slows down

0:30  Soft dawn stillness
0:40  Coming back to calm
0:50  The body settles

⏱ BEST FOR
